Every fish in Stardew Valley is starting to remember you—and form an opinion about you.
Fishing Expanded turns the fishing minigame into a[b] fair, deep, and endlessly [/b]addictive career. It doesn't overturn vanilla mechanics, doesn't add fake items, and doesn't cheat.
It feels like a true DLC: it respects vanilla fishing first, then makes it look like this is exactly how the game was always meant to be.

[line]

[b]Numbers[/b]

[list]
[*][b]1000+ bilingual lines of flavor text[/b] : jump shouts, exhaustion gasps, peak moments, battle rewards, Starfruit Tea musings, assist call-outs...[/*]
[*][b]61 crown-worthy fish[/b] — 56 vanilla species plus all 5 legendary fish — each with its own reputation, rank, and showcase effects.[/*]
[*][b]24 honorifics carved for the rank ladder[/b], matching every rank a fish can hold within its own kind.[/*]
[*][b]495 lines of game-design spec, 12 full design overhauls, our review framework torn down and rebuilt twice, and 100+ live acceptance-test records.[/b][/*]
[*][b]17 signature mechanics[/b]: fish reputation, internal population ranks, crowns that reshape rod handling, crown assists, personalized giant-fish reactions from villagers, seeded boss fights, the reworked Challenge Bait system, exhaustion, truce, mercy on losing streaks, practice matches against mediocre fish, perseverance rewards, Starfruit Tea, crab-pot progression, a festival fishing toggle, per-player multiplayer isolation, and custom titles.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Core Gameplay: Your Reputation — Every Species Keeps Its Own Opinion of You[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Every species keeps its own private [b]reputation score[/b] for you, from -10 to 100.[/*]
[*]Low reputation: only their plainest members bother coming out — weak, easy catches. High reputation: they line up to admire you — stronger fish, far better rewards.[/*]
[*]A successful catch raises your reputation; an escape lowers it.[/*]
[*][b]The five legendary fish stay above all of this[/b], keeping their vanilla experience; catching one once grants a crown directly.[/*]
[/list][i]In short: the more they respect you, the harder they try — and the more they give back.[/i]

[size=4][b]How Does Your Reputation Rise After a Successful Catch?[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Perfect catches (no escapes)[/b] earn the most admiration.[/*]
[*]The more escapes, the less they're impressed.[/*]
[*][b]The higher your fishing level, the faster your reputation grows[/b] (max fishing level is fastest).[/*]
[*]Every successful catch is worth at least +1 reputation.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Each Fish's Rank Among Its Own Kind (Some Ranks Are for You to Discover)[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]<1: ???[/*]
[*]1–3: Elite[/*]
[*]4–6: Knight[/*]
[*]7–8: Lord[/*]
[*]9–15: Count[/*]
[*]16–22: Grand Duke[/*]
[*]23–33: Prince[/*]
[*]34–45: Emperor[/*]
[*]46–66: ???[/*]
[*]67–88: ???[/*]
[*]89–99: ???[/*]
[*]100: ???[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]What Changes as Your Reputation Grows[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Harder tests[/b]: highly-rated fish become significantly harder and may use tricks like jumping.[/*]
[*][b]More fish[/b]: catch quantities increase.[/*]
[*][b]Better quality[/b]: reputation 10 guarantees silver, reputation 25 guarantees gold, and reputation 50 guarantees iridium.[/*]
[*][b]More XP[/b]: highly-rated fish are great for fishing mastery.[/*]
[*][b]Bigger fish[/b]: held fish, flying animations, and displays all become larger.[/*]
[*][b]Negative reputation[/b]: only their most ordinary members come out to spar with you — weaker fights, extra catch-bar protection, perfect for learning.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Crowns: More Than a Collection[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Normal fish grant a [b]crown[/b] in the collection page after a successful catch while they [b]hold you in high regard[/b].[/*]
[*]The 5 vanilla legendary fish grant a crown [b]directly on the first catch[/b].[/*]
[*]Crowns have a real effect: [b]your rod handling improves[/b].
[list]
[*]The catch bar becomes more responsive, smoother, and less floaty.[/*]
[*]More crowns mean better handling.[/*]
[*]Countable crowns come from [b]56 normal vanilla fish + 5 vanilla legendary fish[/b]; collecting all 61 gives the ultimate feel.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Reach reputation 95+ and succeed with [b]challenge bait[/b] to upgrade the crown into a [b]flowing golden crown[/b]—purely gorgeous and a great flex. (At reputation 100 + challenge bait, there is even an easter egg.)[/*]
[/list][i]Other mod fish / special entries only display a star as a collection badge; they do not affect rod handling.[/i]

[size=4][b]What Happens When Your Reputation Is High?[/b][/size]

Once a species holds you in high regard, you will meet truly powerful fish: the champions they send can reach a theoretical power of about 5000 (for reference, vanilla legendary fish are usually below 100), with fiercer acceleration and even full-screen leaps.
But the rewards scale up too—catch quantity, XP, and quality all increase significantly. You will never be asked to “fight harder for less.”

[list]
[*][b]Fish can jump[/b]: they leap up and down, requiring faster reactions.[/*]
[*][b]Fish get tired[/b]: the longer the battle, the slower the fish becomes—but your rewards do not decrease.[/*]
[*][b]Truce breaks[/b]: if you hold the rod still for 3 seconds, the fish stops to rest and gives you breathing room.[/*]
[*][b]Backseeding[/b]: the same species at the same reputation level keeps the same behavior until you finally break it, so you can learn and practice.[/*]
[*][b]Fish assistance[/b]: fish you have already conquered may assist you in battle, greatly extending your catch bar, even bring you a Seafoam Pudding![/*]
[*][b]Challenge Bait = Harder Boss Fights[/b]: only against highly-rated fish, the vanilla challenge bait system is reworked:
[list]
[*]The fish no longer gets tired. No assistance.[/*]
[*]Catching within 5 minutes grants extra quantity.[/*]
[*]After the time limit, stars drop and the catch shrinks, but you [b]can still earn the crown[/b]—it is not all or nothing.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Consecutive failures show mercy[/b]: high-reputation fish escape more slowly in the low catch-bar zone, giving you more chances to learn.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Even Failure Has Consolation Prizes[/b][/size]
Once a day:
[list]
[*]Battles over [b]30 seconds[/b]: chance to receive a +1 fishing dish.[/*]
[*]Battles over [b]60 seconds[/b]: chance to receive a +2 fishing dish. [/*]
[/list][i]Your effort is never wasted; patience pays off.[/i]

[b]A Giant Appears—The Whole Village Stares.[/b]
At high levels, you can catch absurdly huge fish. Nearby villagers will gasp in awe—each with personality-flavored praise (50+ characters and even animal friends have unique lines). But show them off early—once you enter your farmhouse, that giant fish only lives on in legend (and in the size record).

[size=4][b]Starfruit Tea (Late-Game Bonus)[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Once a species' reputation with you reaches [b]50+[/b], successful catches have a chance to drop [b]Starfruit Tea[/b].[/*]
[*]The higher your reputation, the higher the chance; around 25% at reputation 100.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Trash, Algae, and Crab Pots[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Trash, algae and crab pots keep score too, but their opinion of you caps at [b]8[/b].[/*]
[*]At opinion 8, each catch gives up to 8 items.[/*]
[*]Crab pot hauls also count as a “success,” but each pot can only be collected once per day, so it is naturally limited.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Settings (Good to Know)[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Works [b]out of the box[/b] with no required configuration.[/*]
[*][b]Festival fishing is fully vanilla by default[/b]:
[list]
[*]Keep default for fair festival competitions.[/*]
[*]Enable mod rules in GMCM if you want to use the mod to score higher.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Mod logging can be enabled (useful for bug reports).[/*]
[*]Supports [b]resetting all challenge progress[/b].[/*]
[*]Supports custom rank titles; edit the config file manually (not in GMCM).[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Quick Start Guide[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]New players[/b]: first build positive reputation with common fish while raising your fishing level.[/*]
[*][b]Mid-game[/b]: collect crowns to improve rod handling.[/*]
[*][b]Going for reputation 100[/b]: recommended with all crowns + max fishing level + 2x Trap Bobbers + Iridium Seafoam Pudding.[/*]
[*][b]Want giant fish[/b]: raise a species' reputation to 8+, then parade it around town before going home.[/*]
[*][b]Want Starfruit Tea[/b]: focus on building reputation 50+ with your favorite species.[/*]
[*][b]Want a real challenge[/b]: equip Challenge Bait and start the backseeding boss fight.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]One-Line Summary[/b][/size]

This mod is not about grinding more—it is about making [b]every cast feel like growth, surprise, and story[/b].

Your reputation with the fish keeps rising, and so does your skill. Your next cast might be the one that makes you a legend.

[list]

[line]


[size=5][b]Fishing Expanded — 让星露谷的每一条鱼都记住你[/b][/size]


星露谷的每一条鱼，都开始记得你——也开始对你有了评价。
Fishing Expanded 把钓鱼小游戏做成一段公平、耐玩、越钓越上头的完整生涯。不推翻原有机制，没有凭空造物，没有作弊。
它像一个真正的 DLC：先完全尊重原版钓鱼，再让它看起来本来就该是这样。

[size=4][b]内容量[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]1000+ 条中英双语文案[/b]（中文与英文逐条配对）：鱼跃的喊话、力竭的喘息、巅峰时刻、战斗奖励、星之果茶碎碎念、鱼的协助吆喝...[/*]
[*][b]61 条值得加冕的鱼[/b]——56 种原版鱼加全部 5 条传奇鱼，每一条都有独立的评价、头衔与展示效果。[/*]
[*][b]24 个为头衔阶梯刻出来的敬语[/b]，对应鱼在自己种群里的不同职阶。[/*]
[*][b]495 行游戏设计文档、12 次推翻重来的设计打磨、评审框架整个推倒重写了两次、100+ 条实测验收记录。[/b][/*]
[*][b]17 项专属机制[/b]：鱼群声誉、种群内部头衔、重塑手感的皇冠、皇冠助战、巨型鱼个性化赞叹、背板种子的Boss 战、重做挑战鱼饵机制、力竭、停战、连败放水保护、平庸个体练手局、持久战安慰奖、星之果茶、蟹笼升级线、节日钓鱼开关、多人逐玩家数据隔离、自定义称号。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]核心玩法：你的声誉——每个鱼群都有自己的看法[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]每一个鱼种都对你持有一份独立的[b]评价[/b]（-10 ~ 100），这就是你在该鱼群中挣来的[b]声誉[/b]。[/*]
[*]声誉低：出面的多是它们族里最普通的成员——鱼更弱、更容易钓；声誉高：整个鱼群都对你肃然起敬——鱼更强、奖励更好。[/*]
[*]成功钓起，你的声誉就涨一分；脱杆跑鱼，声誉就跌一分。[/*]
[*][b]五大传奇鱼不掺和这套评价[/b]，保持原版体验；钓到一次直接给皇冠。[/*]
[/list][i]总之：声誉是实打实挣来的。鱼群越尊敬你，考验就越认真——给的好处也越多。[/i]

[size=4][b]一次成功，你的声誉怎么涨？[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]完美钓起（没脱杆）[/b]最让它们敬佩。[/*]
[*]脱杆次数越多，它们越不买账。[/*]
[*][b]你的钓鱼等级越高，你的声誉涨得越快[/b]（满级钓鱼等级最快）。[/*]
[*]每次成功至少涨一点声誉，保底不落空。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]鱼在自己种群内的头衔（部分头衔需要玩家亲自发现）[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]<1：？？？[/*]
[*]1–3：精英[/*]
[*]4–6：骑士[/*]
[*]7–8：领主[/*]
[*]9–15：伯爵[/*]
[*]16–22：大公[/*]
[*]23–33：亲王[/*]
[*]34–45：帝王[/*]
[*]46–66：？？？[/*]
[*]67–88：？？？[/*]
[*]89–99：？？？[/*]
[*]100：？？？[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]声誉升高后的变化[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]考验更难[/b]：高声誉鱼种会明显变强，还会出现“跳鱼”等花招。[/*]
[*][b]鱼更多[/b]：钓到的数量会变多。[/*]
[*][b]品质更好[/b]：声誉 10 保底银星、25 保底金星、50 保底铱星。[/*]
[*][b]经验更多[/b]：高声誉鱼刷钓鱼精通特别快。[/*]
[*][b]鱼更大[/b]：钓上来后拿在手里、飞行动画、展示都会变大。[/*]
[*][b]负数声誉[/b]：出面的多是族里最普通的平庸个体，专程找你练练手——鱼更弱，蓄力槽保护更强，正好当练手。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]皇冠：不只是收藏[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]普通鱼在[b]高声誉下成功钓起[/b]后，图鉴会获得[b]皇冠[/b]。[/*]
[*]原版 5 条传奇鱼[b]钓到一次直接给皇冠[/b]。[/*]
[*]皇冠的作用是实实在在的：[b]鱼竿手感变好[/b]。
[list]
[*]绿条更跟手、更顺滑、不拖泥带水。[/*]
[*]皇冠越多，手感越好。[/*]
[*]可计数皇冠来自 [b]56 种普通原生鱼 + 5 条原版传奇鱼[/b]，集齐这 61 个 = 完全体手感。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]声誉达到 95 以上，再用[b]挑战鱼饵[/b]成功钓起，皇冠会升级成[b]流动金色皇冠[/b]，纯粹好看又能秀。（声誉 100 + 挑战鱼饵，还有彩蛋）[/*]
[/list][i]其他 Mod 鱼/特殊条目只显示“星星”，作为收藏；不影响手感。[/i]

[size=4][b]声誉很高时会发生什么？[/b][/size]

当一个鱼种对你评价极高，你会遇见真正强大的对手：它们派出的精锐（甚至神级职阶）战力理论上可达约 5000（相对而言，原版鱼王一般在 100 以内）、加速更凶，甚至能整段横跳。
但奖励同步拉满——鱼获、经验、品质大幅增强。你永远不会被要求“打得更难，拿得更少”。

[list]
[*][b]鱼会跳[/b]：上蹿下跳，需要更快反应。[/*]
[*][b]鱼会累[/b]：战斗时间越长，鱼会慢慢变慢，但你的奖励不减少。[/*]
[*][b]可以停战[/b]：你 3 秒不动鱼竿，鱼会停下来休息，给你喘口气的时间。[/*]
[*][b]背板机制[/b]：同一种鱼、同一档声誉，在你成功破招之前，行为会固定。可以记招、练招。[/*]
[*][b]鱼的协助[/b]：已经收入麾下的鱼，有一定概率战斗中协助，大幅增加你的钓鱼条长度, 甚至可以带来海泡布丁！[/*]
[*][b]挑战鱼饵 = 更难的 Boss 战[/b]：仅对高声誉的鱼，重做原版挑战鱼饵机制：
[list]
[*]鱼不再会累。不再有协助。[/*]
[*]5 分钟内钓到有额外数量加成。[/*]
[*]超时后星星会掉，鱼获变少，但[b]仍有机会拿到皇冠[/b]，不会血本无归。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]连续失败会“放水”[/b]：高声誉的鱼在低条区逃跑速度会变慢，给你更多熟悉机会。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]失败了也有安慰奖（每天一次）[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]战斗超过 [b]30 秒[/b]：有概率获得 +1 钓鱼料理。[/*]
[*]战斗超过 [b]60 秒[/b]：有概率获得 +2 钓鱼料理。 [/*]
[/list][i]肝不会白肝，耐心有回报。[/i]

[b]巨物登场，全村围观。[/b]
高等级之后，你能钓起大到离谱的鱼：附近村民会用各自口吻赞叹——50 多位角色（甚至包括一些特殊村民和动物朋友~）都有专属台词。不过要炫耀就得趁早——一旦走进农舍，这条巨鱼就只存在于传说（和尺寸记录）里了。

[size=4][b]星之果茶（后期福利）[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]某个鱼种对你的声誉 [b]≥50[/b] 后，成功钓起有几率获得[b]星之果茶[/b]。[/*]
[*]声誉越高概率越高，声誉 100 时约 25%。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]垃圾、藻类、蟹笼[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]垃圾、藻类和蟹笼也会评价你，但封顶 [b]8[/b]。[/*]
[*]评价到 8 后每次最多拿 8 个。[/*]
[*]蟹笼收获也算“成功”，但每个笼子每天只能收一次，天然有限。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]设置（建议知道）[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]默认[b]开箱即玩[/b]，不用改任何设置。[/*]
[*][b]节日钓鱼默认完全原版[/b]：
[list]
[*]想公平比赛，保持默认。[/*]
[*]想用 Mod 规则冲高分，可以在 GMCM 里开启。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]可以开启 Mod 日志（遇到 bug 使用）。[/*]
[*]支持[b]重置全部挑战进度[/b]。[/*]
[*]支持自定义称号，仅支持编辑 config 文件修改。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]快速上手指南[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]新手期[/b]：先让常见鱼对你有正声誉，顺便练高钓鱼等级。[/*]
[*][b]中后期[/b]：收集皇冠，提升鱼竿手感。[/*]
[*][b]想冲声誉 100[/b]：建议全皇冠 + 钓鱼等级满级 + 2*陷阱浮标 + 铱星海泡布丁。[/*]
[*][b]想看巨型鱼[/b]：把某个鱼种的声誉刷到 8 以上，钓到后别急着进家门，举着去人多的地方。[/*]
[*][b]想刷星之果茶[/b]：优先把喜欢的鱼种刷到声誉 50 以上。[/*]
[*][b]想挑战自我[/b]：换上挑战鱼饵，开始背板 Boss 战。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]一句话总结[/b][/size]

这个 Mod 不是让你更肝，而是让[b]每一次抛竿都有成长、有惊喜、有故事[/b]。

你的声誉越来越高，你也越来越强。下一杆，可能就是你封神的那一杆。
[line]
[b]FAQ[/b]
[b]1. 难度 4000+ 的鱼真的能钓上来吗？[/b]
是的，它不是祝尼魔过山车 [b][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Junimo_Kart]Junimo Kart[/url]那种感觉[/b] 。但是如果玩家打开困难模式，就不好说了。
[b]2. 兼容性如何？[/b]
[list]
[*]与其他修改钓鱼小游戏玩法的模组[b]不兼容[/b]； 与WalkOfLife兼容，但其所有钓鱼相关功能不会生效，建议不要选择[b]Fisher 或[/b] [b]Angler 职业。[/b][/*]
